728 on First League Night with new Chronic Paranoia
Got a really nice christmas gift from my girlfriend and had it drilled up ASAP.
First league night I bowled everyone\'s socks off with a 728 (248-246-234).

And not to mention the amount of messengers I got. This ball hits like a freight-train.
This is officially my new favourite ball.
Would recommend it to anyone I know.
